recommendation: Keep the core audit as-is. If the current THO ICD page should be updated again for modern ICD-11 wording, handle that through THO/UTG rather than by reintroducing or duplicating ICD usage prose in FHIR core.
issue_request: FHIR-31601 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification Vocabulary issue asking FHIR core to update or remove the ICD page sentence saying ICD-11 was scheduled for release in 2017.
initial_application: Commit ba29899f03 applied FHIR-31601 by adding the requested ICD-11 release/history sentence to source/icd.html while that page still lived in FHIR core.
additional_context: FHIR-35933 later removed the external code system usage pages from FHIR core and moved their content to THO. Current core source no longer has source/icd.html; source/terminologies-systems.html links ICD usage to https://terminology.hl7.org/ICD.html and says THO is authoritative for external terminology guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source change was made because the current FHIR build only owns the THO handoff, not the ICD usage page content.

related_jiras.note: Moved the relevant external-code-system usage pages from FHIR core to THO.
Implemented the corresponding THO-side migration of Using X external code system pages.
